## Overview

iPhone 15 Pro is listed in our worldwide phone directory. Country or market recorded: not recorded. This is an evergreen reference guide, not a new launch or a claim that the institution or product was recently announced.

## Source-listed information

- **Manufacturer:** Apple Inc.
- **Display:** 15 Pro: 6.1 in (155 mm) 2556 × 1179 resolution 15 Pro Max: 6.7 in (170 mm) 2796 × 1290 resolution Super Retina XDR OLED, 120 Hz, HDR10 , 19.5:9 aspect ratio (~460 ppi density), 1000 nits (typ), 2000 nits (peak) supplied by Samsung Display [ 5 ]
- **Processor:** The iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max feature the Apple A17 Pro system on a chip (SoC). It is built on TSMC 's N3B fabrication process . [ 16 ] It features a redesigned Apple graphics processing unit (GPU) which adds hardware-accelerated ray tracing ; during the reveal event, Apple announced that games such as Death Stranding , Resident Evil Village and Assassin's Creed Mirage (all games originally designed for consoles and PCs) would come to iOS in the future. [ 17 ]
- **Battery:** 15 Pro: 12.70 Wh ( 3274 mAh ) Li-ion @ 3.88 V 15 Pro Max: 17.32 Wh ( 4422 mAh ) Li-ion @ 3.9 V [ 3 ]
- **Ram:** 8 GB
- **Storage:** 128 GB (Pro only) 256 GB 512 GB 1 TB NVMe
- **Cameras:** 48 MP, f /1.78 , 24 mm (wide), 1/1.28", 1.22 μm, dual pixel PDAF, sensor-shift OIS 12 MP, f /2.2 , 13 mm, 120° (ultrawide), 1/2.55", 1.4 μm, dual pixel PDAF 15 Pro: 12 MP, f /2.8 , 77 mm (telephoto), 1 μm, PDAF, OIS, 3× optical zoom, lidar sensor 15 Pro Max: 12 MP, f /2.8 , 120 mm (telephoto), 1.12 μm, PDAF, 3D sensor-shift, OIS, 5× optical zoom, lidar sensor
- **Charging:** MagSafe and Qi 2 wireless charging [ 4 ] USB-C (fast-charge capable: up to 50% charge in 30 minutes with 20W adaptor or higher) (Up to 50% charge in 20 minutes with 40W adaptor or higher)
- **Connectivity:** Wi-Fi 6E (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax) tri-band Bluetooth 5.3 ( A2DP , LE ) Ultra-wideband (UWB) Thread NFC (reader mode, Express Cards) LEO satellite ( Globalstar , limited) USB-C : USB 10Gbps Dual-frequency GPS ( L1, L5 ), GLONASS , Galileo , QZSS , BeiDou , NavIC
- **Os:** Original: iOS 17 Current: iOS 27.2 , released October 26, 2026 ( 2026-10-26 ) [ 1 ]
- **Front Camera:** 12 MP, f / 1.9, 23 mm (wide), 1/3.6", PDAF, OIS SL 3D (depth/biometrics)
- **Weight:** 15 Pro: 187 g (6.6 oz) 15 Pro Max: 221 g (7.8 oz)
- **Dimensions:** dimensions: 15 Pro: H: 146.6 mm (5.77 in) W: 70.6 mm (2.78 in) D: 8.25 mm (0.325 in) 15 Pro Max: H: 159.9 mm (6.30 in) W: 76.7 mm (3.02 in) D: 8.25 mm (0.325 in)
- **Protection:** IP68 dust/water resistant (up to 6 m for 30 mins)
- **Color:** White titanium Blue titanium Natural titanium Black titanium
